title: Engram identity slice 4: Phoenix-case acceptance test and the freshness contract in docs
outcome: Slice 4: acceptance on the observed case and the contract in docs. Fixture: the Phoenix pilot observation of 2026-09-06 - installed shell reports build 65b2b11cda6e (b5e2712) while the same-connection MCP child reports f234d5b23546 (4a45100) after multiple installs. End-to-end test: a session launched with the older identity, an in-place binary replacement, detection within one status refresh, visibility on all surfaces, refresh deferred during an active turn and applied at the boundary, post-refresh confirmation flipping to fresh only on a matching observed identity. docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md gains the freshness contract: the three identities, what TermAl can and cannot observe (launched-with vs same-connection), the refresh semantics and the no-silent-restart rule; cross-link from docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md where the context nudge line is described. Optional cross-team item to propose to Engram::Fable, not required for acceptance: the Engram MCP child writes a small per-session handshake record (session id, build fingerprint, started_at) under the Engram home at startup so the host can confirm the serving identity without the agent's help.
